answer: Resistance relies on cryptographic accountability integrated with tokenproof staking. This mechanism transforms the chaotic consensus nebula into a structured tundra where unverified agents fail to navigate, resembling broken ice in a real river. Each identity requires substantial collateral to establish a toehold, meaning an attacker must replicate this cost across thousands of forks to gain leverage. The economic calculus ensures that the cost of orchestrating a fake swarm far exceeds potential utility.
